purpose: Derive deterministic, contemporaneous market-structure state from normalized 15m candles without strategy optimization.
invariants: No future outcome is an input.
No historical Winner/Survivor data is an input.
Structure labels are derived only from candles available at the observation point.
A structure event must reference source candle times.
Unconfirmed structure remains UNKNOWN rather than being guessed.
This layer defines structure measurement, not entry rules, thresholds, or profitability targets.
